description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Native and ERC-20 balances of an address, ALL read at one stated block (number and hash returned). Token decimals are read from the token contract, never assumed; an address with no code, or a contract that is not a standard ERC-20, is an error and is never reported as a zero balance. Amounts are exact strings.

address.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

block.description: "latest" (default), "safe", "finalized", or a decimal block number. Every value in the answer is read at this one block

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

name: evm_balance
title: EVM balances at one block
